'''JordanCon''' is an annual convention in [[wikipedia:Atlanta, Georgia|Atlanta]]. It originally started and still largely focuses on the ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series of books, but has grown somewhat to encompass other works by [[Robert Jordan]], other southern literature, and other [[wikipedia:Tor Books|Tor Books]] authors.

In 2013 JordanCon V will also be the site of the 51st annual DeepSouthCon.
